subject: Invoice routing, tax evidence & net-terms proposal (Order Form)
messages:
From: Lucas Meyer <l.meyer@auroramed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@auroramed.com
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice entity & tax evidence

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Aurora is keen to move forward, but our finance team has two blocking items before procurement will sign:

1) Invoice routing: we need invoices split between Aurora Medical Systems (FR entity) and Aurora Diagnostics GmbH (DE entity) depending on consumption region. Can Redwood provide an invoice schedule that maps seat/usage tiers to the entity invoiced?

2) Tax evidence: our AP team requires a copy of Redwood’s VAT registration (EU VAT certificate) and confirmation of which entity will be responsible for VAT withholding.

Also, on net terms: Aurora prefers Net 60 for the initial quarter while we finalize PO flows. Is Redwood able to accept Net 60 for the first invoice and Net 30 thereafter?

We’ve attached a short template of the PO fields we need included. If you can send a proposed invoice cadence and any required tax docs, we’ll queue this for legal/procurement review.

Best,
Lucas
Procurement Manager
Aurora Medical Systems

Attachment: Aurora_PO_fields_template.csv (csv)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucas Meyer <l.meyer@auroramed.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice entity & tax evidence

Thanks Lucas — looping in Ben and Laura to close the gaps. Quick proposal from my side to unblock procurement:

- Invoicing: We can issue invoices per-entity by mapping usage by region at month-end. Initial setup will be manual (export + split) but we can automate from month 2 onward.
- Net terms: Redwood can accept Net 60 for the first invoice only, then revert to Net 30. We’ll need this callout in the Order Form and a PO referencing the first invoice number.
- Taxes: We can provide our EU VAT registration and provide an invoice that shows VAT charged by the applicable Redwood entity. If Aurora requests withholding language, we’ll need a short form to confirm which invoices are subject to withholding — Ben, legal input?

Ben/Laura — can you: (a) confirm Redwood’s billing entity options and suggested wording for the Order Form that describes the entity split, (b) prepare a short list of required tax artifacts we can send to Aurora, and (c) confirm any accounting/AR-side constraints if we accept Net 60 for the first invoice?

I’ll draft the reply to Lucas and attach the Order Form v3 and a DocuSign link once we have wording.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucas Meyer <l.meyer@auroramed.com>, procurement@auroramed.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice entity & tax evidence

Jonas / Laura / Lucas — legal & finance alignment below (high level). I attached a tracked-redlines doc for the Order Form.

Key points:
- Entity mapping: We can support separate invoice entities: Redwood Inference Ltd (UK/EU), Redwood Inference GmbH (DE), Redwood Inference Inc. (US). For Aurora, we recommend Redwood Inference GmbH invoice for DE/EEA usage and Redwood Inference Ltd for FR usage if required by Aurora’s tax team.
- Order Form language: Add a clause: “Invoices will be issued by the Redwood entity listed on the invoice. Redwood will use reasonable efforts to split charges by consumption geography; any initial manual splitting may be subject to reconciliation on subsequent invoices.” That gives us leeway during month 1 automation.
- Net terms: Agree to Net 60 for initial invoice only; require PO referencing initial invoice number and an acknowledgement that subsequent invoices default to Net 30. We will add a short exception to collections policy for this deal.
- Tax evidence: We will share: (a) VAT registration certificate (EU), (b) Redwood’s tax residency letter, (c) sample invoice template showing VAT fields. Aurora withholding: if Aurora withholds, they must provide documentation (tax withholding certificate) and include withholding instructions in the PO.
- Revenue recognition: Finance flagged that splitting revenue across entities may affect ASC 606 mapping — we’ll reconcile at month close and provide a consolidated invoice/statement to Aurora monthly.

Attachments: redlines_orderform_benc_jw.docx (docx), aurora_tax_cert_FR.pdf (pdf)

Next steps I suggest: Jonas send the proposed wording and the Order Form v3 (attached) to Aurora with the DocuSign envelope; ask procurement to include PO reference for the initial invoice and confirm which entity to invoice for the first 60-day invoice.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Meyer <l.meyer@auroramed.com>, procurement@auroramed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoice entity & tax evidence

Lucas — thanks for the clear list. Per Ben’s notes above, attached are: (1) Aurora_OrderForm_v3.pdf (Order Form with proposed invoice-entity clause and Net 60 first-invoice fallback), (2) redlines_orderform_benc_jw.docx (tracked changes), and (3) aurora_tax_cert_FR.pdf (VAT cert).

Proposed asks for procurement to finalize so we can route to signature:
1) Confirm which Aurora legal entity should receive the first invoice (Aurora Medical Systems FR or Aurora Diagnostics GmbH DE).
2) Add the initial PO number in the DocuSign signing comments so the first invoice can be issued Net 60.
3) If Aurora intends to withhold VAT, please attach the withholding certificate to the PO.

I’ve started a DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC1234DEF — I’ll include the final Order Form once you confirm the entity and PO number. If procurement confirms today, we can sign and issue the first invoice next week.

Thanks and let me know if you want a quick call to walk through the invoice split mechanics.

—Jonas
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aurora_OrderForm_v3.pdf (pdf), redlines_orderform_benc_jw.docx (docx), aurora_tax_cert_FR.pdf (pdf)
